name: gallery_of_nobody
title: The Gallery of Nobody
description: A tall, quiet gallery of small landscapes with handwriting on the back. A bench in the middle for someone who never sits.

writings.text: DO NOT TURN THE PAINTINGS (turn the paintings)

paintings.title: Lake, morning
paintings.text: Survey log 2. The galleries out here hang the same lake again and again, a little greener each time. I think the building is practising.

paintings.title: A road
paintings.text: This road goes to the place the building copied. I have walked it in my head every night. It ends in a carpet.

paintings.title: House with one window
paintings.text: There is a light on in the window. There was not a light on when I hung it.

paintings.title: Self-portrait
paintings.text: The face was left blank on purpose. The copy did not know what we look like.

paintings.title: Corridor
paintings.text: Survey log 3. Hum pitch drops about a quarter tone every few hundred metres from the origin rooms. Use it like a compass: the truer the hum, the closer you are to the source.

paintings.title: Exit
paintings.text: Every room has a door on each side. I counted. I counted again. Five.
